description: Mappedin SDKs provide developers with the tools needed to integrate advanced indoor mapping capabilities into their applications. These software development kits offer a range of features, including customizable map views, real-time navigation, and interactive wayfinding. AI code assistants: see https://docs.mappedin.com/android-sdk-api/v6/latest/llms.txt and https://developer.mappedin.com/llms-mappedin-android.txt for API guidance.
